title: Department Top Earners
description:
Write a query to find the top 3 highest paid employees in each department.

Table: employees
Columns: id, name, salary, department_id

Your query should return department_id and salary, ordered by department_id (ascending) and then salary (descending).

Note: If a department has fewer than 3 employees, return all of them.
starter_code:
SELECT department_id, salary
FROM employees
WHERE -- your solution here
